jobs_results.title: Fresher Accountant
jobs_results.description: Looking to build a career as a Fresher Accountant? Whispering Palms Hotel wants someone dependable, quick to learn and ready to own their work, based in Jaipur. Day to day, you will handle the core tasks of the finance & accounting function, support senior colleagues, and make sure your work is accurate, on time and to a high standard. You will get structured guidance early on and increasing independence as you grow into the role. We care most about attitude: strong communication, reliability, and a real desire to learn. Relevant skills (Accounting, Tally, Excel, GST, Bookkeeping) are a plus but many can be taught on the job. You will be trained and mentored throughout, work to clear expectations, and have a genuine path to grow into a more senior position as you deliver. If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

jobs_results.title: US Accounts Associate (Bhainslana)
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented US Tax Accountant to join our team. This opportunity is ideal for CA Freshers or CA Inter candidates who are interested in building a career in US Accounting and Taxation. The candidate will support tax compliance, accounting operations, financial reporting, and bookkeeping activities while working closely with senior team members.

Key Responsibilities

- Prepare journal entries and maintain general ledger records.
- Perform bank, credit card, and account reconciliations.
- Assist in month-end and year-end closing activities.
- Support preparation of financial statements and management reports.
- Handle bookkeeping activities using accounting software such as QuickBooks or NetSuite.
- Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable processes.
- Maintain organized financial records and documentation.
- Support budgeting, reporting, and financial data analysis activities.
- Ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting entries and records.
- Coordinate with internal teams for financial and accounting requirements.

Required Qualifications 
- CA Fresher / CA Inter / Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, or Finance.
- Basic understanding of accounting principles and taxation concepts.
- Interest in US Accounting
- Familiarity with MS Excel and accounting software is preferred.
- Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.
- Good verbal and written communication skills.
- Ability to work in a team-oriented and deadline-driven workplace. .
